text:
Rhea: Noticed a weird UX on foldables — when the console is in split mode the right-hand panel(inspection) overlaps the table's inline controls. Users can't reach the quick edit for a row. Video: https://imgur.com/foldable-ux.mp4
Tom: repro on Galaxy Fold (unfolded). Steps: open Console > Rules table > enable split-view > try to tap row quick-edit. The panel sits above the table even though visually itappears separate.
Luca: seems like a stacking context issue. The panel uses transform: translateZ(0) for perf which creates a new stacking context and lifts it above the table. Quick fix: avoid unnecessary transforms and use will-change sparingly.
Ana: from product POV we need the inline controls to stay reachable in all modes. Two options: 1) collapse right panel to icon-only in split mode, 2) float the inline controls above the panel when needed. Prefer 1 for predictability.
Rhea: UX idea: in split mode show a persistent thin drag handle (24px) on the panel and reserve 48px from the table container so row actions remain tappable. Also make the handle reachable with larger hit area.
Tom: implementable CSS snippet: `@media (min-width: 900px) and (max-width: 1100px) { .panel--split { width: 240px; } .table-container { margin-right: 48px; transform: translateZ(0); } }` But transform on table container might reintroduce stacking issues. Maybe use padding instead of transform.
Luca: accessibility: when the panel is open in split mode it should get `aria-expanded=true` and keyboard focus should be trapped only if the panel is in modal mode (overlay). For split mode we should not trap focus. Also ensure row quick-edit buttons have `aria-live` polite announcements when shown.
Ana: copy tweak: change "Edit" -> "Quick edit" on the inline menu for clarity on mobile. Also make sure the tooltip text doesn't rely on hover; use accessible labels instead.
Rhea: QA found another edge: when switching from folded to unfolded, the table reflows causing content jump and the focused row loses its visible focus ring. Need to preserve focus visibility across viewport changes.
Tom: solution: store the focused element id before resize, and after reflow reapply focus and call `element.scrollIntoView({block: 'nearest', behavior: 'auto'})`. Add a debounce for resize events to avoid thrash.
Luca: to reduce reflow churn use `contain: layout;` on table cells and avoid percentage widths for action column at small breakpoints. Use `max-width` + `min-width` clamps.
ux-bot: new figma file with split-mode rules and reserved tap area: https://figma.com/file/SPLIT/console-foldable :pushpin:
Ana: can we also add a small micro-animation when quick-edit pops over the row so screen readers announce the change? Maybe add `role="status"` to the floating toolbar and `aria-live="polite"`.
Rhea: assigning RD-3621 as P3 with target next sprint. Tom will prototype CSS change and Luca will run accessibility checks. I'll add device lab repro steps and a short capture to the ticket. Thanks!
